_comment: Reference language. Every key must exist here; other languages may omit keys and fall back to this file. Keys prefixed 'Log' are written to the Emby log and are deliberately never translated - they must not appear in any other language file.
EditorDescription: Routes outbound HTTP(S) traffic initiated by the Emby core (metadata providers, remote images, subtitle downloads) through a proxy. Private networks and short hostnames are contacted directly unless you switch that off.
DescEnableProxy: When disabled, Emby behaves exactly as it would without this plugin.
DescScheme: Only used when the proxy address does not carry a scheme of its own.
DescProxyAddress: Either host:port (for example 192.168.1.10:8080) or a full URL (for example socks5://192.168.1.10:1080). Put credentials in the fields below - .NET ignores credentials embedded in the URL for SOCKS5.
DescUsername: Optional. Takes precedence over credentials embedded in the URL.
DescIgnoreCert: Required for HTTPS proxies using a self-signed certificate. Only takes effect while the proxy is enabled and configured, but then it applies to every outbound connection the Emby core makes - the proxy itself, the destinations tunnelled through it, and the destinations that go out directly because they are on the bypass list.
LabelFailOpen: Connect directly when the proxy is unavailable
DescFailOpen: OFF (default, fail-closed): if the proxy is unreachable, affected requests are aborted and logged. ON (fail-open): requests go straight out to the internet without the proxy - every such case is logged as a warning.
DescBypassPrivate: ON (default): private networks (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x), link-local, IPv6 ULA, *.local and hostnames without a dot (nas, router) are contacted directly. OFF: they go through the proxy too - which under fail-closed means an unreachable proxy also cuts the server off from its own LAN. Only switch this off if the proxy is genuinely the machine's only route outward. The server's own loopback address is never proxied either way.
DescBypassList: Additional entries, one per line. Accepts CIDR (10.0.0.0/8), a single IP, a hostname, or a wildcard (*.example.com). No DNS resolution is performed - hostnames are matched literally. Entries here are additional to whatever the switch above covers, and they apply even when it is off. Emby's licensing servers are not bypassed by default - add them here if you want them contacted directly.
DescCheckUrlHttp: Tests whether the proxy forwards plain HTTP. Must answer 2xx; redirects are not followed and therefore fail. Leave empty to skip this check.
DescCheckUrlHttps: Tests whether the proxy opens a CONNECT tunnel - this is the path almost all of Emby's traffic takes. A proxy can forward HTTP and still refuse CONNECT, which is why both are checked and both must succeed. Leave both fields empty to check TCP connectivity only.
PatchActive: Active - Emby core traffic passes through this plugin.
PatchDegraded: Active, but the proxy could not be attached to at least one HTTP handler: {0} Those requests are still blocked under fail-closed, but they do not go through the proxy. Restarting the server usually clears this.
PatchInactive: NOT active - {0} No traffic is being redirected.
FailOpenText: If the proxy fails, requests go straight to the internet WITHOUT the proxy (logged as a warning).
FailClosedText: If the proxy fails, affected requests are blocked. No silent fallback to a direct connection.
DisabledText: The proxy is switched off; Emby connects directly.
UnreachableSuffixFailOpen: - requests are currently going out directly.
CheckingTextFailOpen: No check result yet. Until then, requests go out directly.
CheckingTextFailClosed: No check result yet. Until then, affected requests are blocked.
HealthTcpOnlyOk: TCP connect succeeded (no HTTP check configured)
HealthAllHttpOk: All {0} HTTP checks via {1} succeeded ({2} ms total)
HealthUrlRequired: TCP reachable, but an HTTP check failed: {0}
HealthTcpTimeout: TCP connect to {0}:{1} timed out after {2} s
LogReasonBypassed: destination is on the bypass list
LogReasonNotChecked: proxy status has not been checked yet
LogCheckUrlInvalid: Check URL '{0}' is not a valid absolute URL and was ignored - the {1} probe is not running.
LogCheckUrlScheme: Check URL '{0}' was ignored: the {1} field needs a {1}:// URL, this one is {2}://. That probe is not running, so a proxy can now pass the check without its {1} path having been exercised.
LogBlocked: Proxy unreachable - request blocked: {0} ({1}). Fail-closed is active.
LogFailOpen: Fail-open active - request is going out DIRECTLY, without the proxy: {0} ({1})
ErrInvalidUrl: Proxy address is not a valid URL: {0}
ErrUnsupportedScheme: Unsupported proxy scheme '{0}'. Supported schemes are http, https and socks5.
ErrNeedPort: Proxy address needs a port, for example 192.168.1.10:8080 or socks5://192.168.1.10:1080
ErrPortNotNumber: Proxy port is not a number: {0}
ErrUserInfoNeedsScheme: The proxy address carries credentials but no scheme. Write it as http://user:password@192.168.1.10:8080, or leave the credentials out of the address and use the username and password fields.
ErrInvalidHost: Proxy address contains an invalid host: {0}
ErrNeedExplicitPort: Proxy address needs an explicit port.
ErrPrefixFamily: Prefix length does not match the address family: {0}
ErrIntervalMin: The check interval must be at least {0} seconds.
ErrIntervalMax: The check interval must not exceed {0} seconds.
ErrCheckUrlScheme: This URL has to start with {0}
